findings.description: Stripe Checkout charges one unit per cart line regardless of quantity, so the hosted total can undercharge versus the in-app cart total.
reproSteps: Add Organic Bananas ($3.49), tap + once so quantity is 2.
Add Avocados ($5.99) and 2% Milk ($4.29) once each.
Click Checkout and compare the Stripe-hosted order total to $17.26.
findings.observedBehavior: In-app total was $17.26; Stripe Checkout showed $13.77 (consistent with one unit per SKU: $3.49 + $5.99 + $4.29). Backend builds each line item with quantity forced to 1.
findings.expectedBehavior: Stripe line items and total must match sum(price × quantity) for every cart row (here $17.26).
